exam.title: CompTIA Linux+ (V8)
exam.study_prerequisites: CompTIA recommends about 12 months of Linux server experience. Practice on Debian- and RPM-family systems: boot/kernel/devices, LVM/RAID/filesystems/mounts, network/shell/backups/virtualization, users/permissions/processes/packages/systemd/containers, authentication/firewalls/hardening/cryptography/compliance, Bash/Python/Git/automation/AI review, and evidence-led break/fix with persistent revalidation after reboot.

review.notes: All five weighted V8 domains are mapped to runtime state, persistent configuration, restart/reboot/recreate and revalidation, with three scenarios, eight cross-distribution break/fix labs and 42 original checks. All seven guide URLs are cataloged: five reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. Distribution-specific behavior is a verification boundary. No proprietary objectives, PBQs, course labs or recalled items are used.

findings.evidence: Objective 4.1 names OpenTofu and orchestration/bootstrap tools; 5.1 covers SLIs/SLOs/SLAs and collection/alerting.
findings.recommendation: Map all 29 numbered objectives and add tool-role and original monitoring cases; do not treat the main-page summary as the complete command list.

findings.title: Umask was described as subtraction
findings.evidence: Linux creation masks clear requested bits; default ACLs alter creation inheritance.
findings.recommendation: Correct explanation with 0666 masked by 0003 yielding 0664, default ACL caveat and checked arithmetic; no native enforcement claim.
findings.resolution: Correct explanation with 0666 masked by 0003 yielding 0664, default ACL caveat and checked arithmetic; no native enforcement claim.

findings.title: ACL masks and mode bits need a precise relationship
findings.evidence: The ACL mask limits named-user/group-class permissions and corresponds to the displayed group-class mode bits for extended ACLs.
findings.recommendation: Add effective-permission case and distinguish owner/other, path traversal and MAC; no blanket override metaphor.
findings.resolution: Add effective-permission case and distinguish owner/other, path traversal and MAC; no blanket override metaphor.

findings.title: The current PDF retains a removed upstream module name
findings.evidence: Objective 3.4 lists pam_tally2; Linux-PAM removed deprecated tally modules in 1.5.0 and points to faillock.
findings.recommendation: Preserve exam recognition, explain current module and different stack configuration, and require distro-supported configuration; no PAM edits.
findings.resolution: Preserve exam recognition, explain current module and different stack configuration, and require distro-supported configuration; no PAM edits.

findings.title: Published utility label differs from documented command
findings.evidence: The PDF lists systemd-blame; upstream documents the systemd-analyze blame subcommand and its activation-timing limits.
findings.recommendation: Add verified name and explain dependency/parallel-start caveats; do not claim a Linux service-manager test.
findings.resolution: Add verified name and explain dependency/parallel-start caveats; do not claim a Linux service-manager test.

findings.title: Shell redirection and pipeline errors need distinct models
findings.evidence: Bash distinguishes << here-documents from <<< here-strings, default last-stage status from pipefail, and subshell context from parent state.
findings.recommendation: Teach the distinction and execute original filename/pipeline examples with negative inputs and producer failure.
findings.resolution: Teach the distinction and execute original filename/pipeline examples with negative inputs and producer failure.

findings.title: Archive mode alone does not preserve every property
findings.evidence: The manual excludes ACLs, xattrs and hard-link preservation from -a and distinguishes trailing-source-slash behavior.
findings.recommendation: Explain separate options/capability checks, preview versus actual restore evidence and destination deletion risk; no rsync run claimed.
findings.resolution: Explain separate options/capability checks, preview versus actual restore evidence and destination deletion risk; no rsync run claimed.

findings.title: Upstream version alone does not establish vulnerability status
findings.evidence: Vendor security fixes can be backported to older-version packages; advisories explain exact affected/fixed builds.
findings.recommendation: Add vendor-package/advisory evidence workflow while avoiding blanket dismissal of scanner findings or current support claims for old article examples.
findings.resolution: Add vendor-package/advisory evidence workflow while avoiding blanket dismissal of scanner findings or current support claims for old article examples.
